values.hypothesis: Showing the delivery date on the cart page means fewer people leave at the shipping step.
values.setup: Half of new visitors saw the delivery date on the cart page, for two weeks. Everyone else saw it at the shipping step, as before.
values.takeaway: Fewer people left at the shipping step, and the difference held in both weeks. Recommend shipping it to everyone.

values.impact: The sales dashboard showed Tuesday’s orders twice for most of Wednesday morning.
values.root-cause: A retried job wrote its batch again after the first attempt had already finished. The load didn’t check for batches it had already written.
fix: [x] Remove the duplicate batch and refresh the dashboard
[ ] Make the load skip a batch it has already written
[ ] Alert when a day’s order count doubles

values.question: Do teams that invite a second person in week one stay longer?
values.method: Teams that signed up from January to June, grouped by whether they invited someone in their first week. Compared how many were still active after 90 days.
values.findings: Teams with an invite stayed noticeably longer. But teams that invite may simply be more serious to begin with; an experiment would settle it.

values.notes: Error is up for the last three weeks, mostly in the two new regions. The model hasn’t seen a full season there yet.
